title: Grass-roots of Adaptation: Strengthening community climate resilience through locally led adaptation in Costa Rica
organization: Fundecooperación para el Desarrollo Sostenible; submitted to the Adaptation Fund
temporal_coverage: Proposal contextualizes historical meteorological records from 1980–2017 and regional adaptation risks; proposal version July 2025.
methodology: Proposal summarizes IMN hazard records and regional risks.
limitations: Applicant proposal; regional summaries rely on prior government analyses and do not attribute events.

title: United Nations organizations’ support to community-driven recovery, risk knowledge and governance enhances disaster and climate resilience in Costa Rica
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
temporal_coverage: Reports 2017 Storm Nate recovery and United Nations-supported risk and resilience work through 2023.
methodology: UNDRR summarizes program activities and risk findings.
limitations: Program account; no independent impact evaluation.

title: Informe de progreso del Plan Nacional de Adaptación al Cambio Climático de Costa Rica 2022-2026
organization: Dirección de Cambio Climático, Ministerio de Ambiente y Energía; GIZ and IISD
temporal_coverage: Implementation progress of the 2022–2026 National Adaptation Plan, assessed through June 2026.
methodology: Questionnaires, consultation and document review assessed NAP products through June 2026.
limitations: Progress covered 179 of 232 products; institutional self-report is not impact evaluation.

title: Proyectos Climáticos
organization: Dirección de Cambio Climático, Ministerio de Ambiente y Energía (MINAE)
temporal_coverage: MINAE project-register entries with stated project durations; the page does not provide publication or project-status dates for every entry.
methodology: Official registry lists project aims, locations and durations.
limitations: Entries describe design; status and outcomes are unreported.
